description: Phone input with country selection, international code and formatting.

howToUse: Use it for phone numbers that can come from more than one country.
Start with the country most people use in `country`, and limit the list with `countries` when only some apply.
The Brazilian format is applied as people type. Validate other countries in your application.
alternatives: A phone that is always from the same country, with no selector: Input with `type="tel"`.

keyboard.action: Moves from the country to the number.
Changes the country, as in a browser select.
